name: Rohonc Codex

phase_0.boundary_condition: The physical binding and folio edges of the manuscript

VINIT.justification: pre-decipherment void before any glyph is named

TANCH.justification: hermetic seal containing the entire manuscript system

CLINK.justification: sequential composition of symbols into pseudo-words

IMSCRIB.justification: self-reference recognizing the codex's own structural rules

FSPLIT.justification: co-multiplication splitting into authentic vs forged interpretations

FFUSE.justification: multiplication reconstituting the original manuscript state from both branches

ENGAGR.justification: simultaneous holding of authentic and hoax evidence without resolution

IFIX.justification: permanent fixation of the resolved/paradice state

phase_3.both_description: simultaneous authentic/hoax evidence, paradice of undeciphered status

steps.domain_action: Genesis of the codex as an unknown artifact before analysis begins
Forward morphism of initial paleographic analysis toward target meaning
Sequential chaining of glyph sequences into candidate pseudo-words
Co-multiplication branching into competing hermeneutic paths
Affirmative branch — matches known morphological rules
Negative branch — fails frequency distribution test
Multiplication reconstituting the candidate word from both T and F arms
Contravariant descent — deconstructs residual false hypotheses
Paradice — simultaneously holds authentic and forged evidence without resolution
Identity — the codex's internal script references its own structural rules
Composition — links self-reference to external scholarly corpus
ROM fixation — permanently records the unresolved paradice state
Terminal anchor — seals the manuscript within the historical archive

phase_5.alfs_store: The Codex itself as the bootstrap reference

phase_6.cycle_cost: Scholarly attention and computational verification cycles
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: Undeciphered artifact with high information entropy
phase_6.post_cycle_state: Archived interpretation with fixed semantic state
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The hermeneutic cycle conserves information; analysis merely maps existing glyph arrangements without creating or destroying semantic potential.
